name: micro
description_en: A modern and intuitive terminal-based text editor
readme_excerpt: micro is a terminal-based text editor that aims to be easy to use and intuitive, while also taking advantage of the capabilities of modern terminals. It comes as a single, batteries-included, static binary with no dependencies; you can download and use it right now! As its name indicates, micro aims to be somewhat of a successor to the nano editor by being easy to install and use.
